chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Zur'arah, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Bukayr ibn A'yan, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
If he divorces her for the waiting period (iddah) more than once, the surplus (of the waiting period) is not for the one [divorce] by the [act of] divorce.

key_terms.الْعِدَّةِ: Waiting period (iddah) after divorce or death

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on multiple divorces given during the waiting period (iddah)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq clarifies the jurisprudential principle that multiple pronouncements of divorce during a single waiting period (iddah) do not cumulatively extend the iddah duration, as the marital bond is considered singular until the final pronouncement is irrevocable. This ruling prevents the husband from manipulating the waiting period by issuing repeated revocable divorces, ensuring the wife's status remains clear and protected under Shia fiqh. It underscores the distinction between revocable (raj'i) and irrevocable (ba'in) divorces in the context of the iddah period.
